friendly_name: Rif Fighters Rout Spain at Annual
description: Berber tribesmen under a local leader overran a Spanish army in northern Morocco in one of colonial Europe's worst defeats.
scene: Rif fighters in hooded djellabas with rifles streaming down a bare mountain ridge into an abandoned Spanish hilltop camp of sandbags, tents and an overturned field gun; the fighters are anonymous figures and no leader is singled out
